jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science
jobs.description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strive to integrate and interpret these data derived from microbiome (e.g., metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, metaproteomics) and host (e.g., genetics, proteomics, circulating metabolomics) in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

In this position, you will be:

• 
Responsible for improving and expanding our current deep learning approaches, while also having a chance to create your own novel approaches.

• 
Expected to participate in and lead existing data science projects within these consortia and the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

• 
Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below, with strong experience in software development.

• 
Computer science (informatics)

• 
Mathematics

• 
Physics

• 
Bioinformatics

• 
Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with strong analytical skills and interdisciplinary experience. Candidates with a solid data science background but lacking biological training are strongly encouraged to apply and include a statement about their motivation for this position and how they anticipate addressing this.

Required qualifications:

• 
PhD in computer science (informatics), mathematics, physics, bioinformatics, or biology with strong experience in software development.

• 
Academic preparation as well as experience in machine learning and statistical analysis.

• 
Strong programming skills and experience using deep learning frameworks (e.g., Python, NumPy, PyTorch, TensorFlow).

• 
Experience with deep learning model architectures, including autoencoders, graph neural networks, and related neural network models.

• 
Familiarity with explainable AI (xAI) methods for interpreting machine learning and deep learning models.

• 
Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

• 
Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

• 
Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

• 
Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

• 
Experience in applying deep learning to biological problems.

• 
Basic understanding of human disease biology and/or microbiology.

• 
Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

• 
Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

• 
Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

• 
Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

• 
International mobility.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 23, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

• 
a motivation letter

• 
a detailed CV

• 
degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

• 
a complete and numbered list of publications

• 
3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

• 
It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

• 
a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

• 
a detailed description of research experience

• 
an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

You’ll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark (for example, EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit). Unfortunately, we’re not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will work with a wide range of carpentry tasks and work closely with the glazing side of the company. We are therefore looking for a carpenter who is comfortable with varied practical work and interested in working across the two trades.

Who you are

• 
You are a qualified carpenter

• 
You have knowledge or practical experience of the glazing trade

• 
You have a valid driving licence

• 
You can communicate in English

• 
Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

• 
A valid asbestos training certificate is a strong advantage

What we offer

• 
Gross hourly wage: DKK 150-200, depending on qualifications and experience

• 
Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

• 
Occasional overtime may occur, but weekend work is generally not required

• 
Pension scheme

About Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas is a local glazing company on Lolland. In addition to glazing work, the company also employs carpenters and carries out a wide range of practical assignments.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

How to apply

Please send your application to rekruttering@lolland.dk and write “Bonde Glas” in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe’s largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk

jobs.occupation: Kitchen assistant, kitchen help - or trained chef
jobs.description:
Attention ladies & gents in Aarhus, or close by  

We are looking for a chef - kitchen assistant or kitchenhelp to our french bistro.

We are 2 small and very cozy restaurants in Jægergårdsgade, Århus, Denmark. And we are pleasantly busy.  

Cheers to the idea that YOU might be one of our new colleagues. We have an ongoing view on all applicants and we welcome new colleagues, when needed. Feel free to send an application to us.

We urge you to go to our SoMe, read about us and see photos of what type of service we do, to get a feel for the atmosphere and the culture we have.

Klassisk Bistro 65, being the characteristic charming French bistro   https://www.klassiskbistro.dk/

Who we are;

We are a wonderful diverse team in nationalities and cultures, around 50 colleagues that come from 12-13 different countries, all over the world - Italy, France, Argentina, UK, Bulgaria, Syria, Slovenia, Poland, Nepal, Russia, DK …. Our spoken language is English with a touch of dialect, charming and very relaxed. 

We are down to earth in mindset and working style, the organisation is flat in structure – so there’s no managers to tell you what to do every 10 minutes, thus we expect you to work independently, focused on your tasks and responsibilities and with an eye for the whole team.

We are looking for the following staff;

Experienced chefs, that have years behind a stow and is used to busy and high pressure service. You are able to keep calm, move fast, make nice food & keep kitchen clean – also when everything is hectic around you. 

Kitchen help, that have min. 6 months experience working in kitchens, helping out with prep for service as well as helping out as a waiter. You are willing to do a lot of helpful stuff when getting ready for service.

We ask of you;

Tattoos, multi-colored trousers, straight hair, no hair, A, B, C, D chest seize, flip beard, mustacho or too much beard…..  We don’t really mind - as long as you have a big smile, are clean, outgoing, service minded, a good helpful colleague, willing to learn new stuff and can move fast in our kitchen. 

Please understand, our team are hardworking people, if you have an addiction problem with drugs, alcohol etc. - you do not need to apply to any of the positions! Its one of our non-negotiables and a key company values.

Acknowledging the importance in following the company rules and guidelines, eg. for best practice in ´cleaning & hygiene´ – is another key factor in our company. We expect of you to be responsible and meet on time and not report sick every second day due to hangovers.

We offer;

·       A lively and nice place to work, no days are alike

·       Salary linked to qualifications (all staff are hourly paid)

·       We teach you, first 3-5 shifts are trial shifts - and you get paid for these too

·       Chance to expand your competencies  

·       Staff food

·       50% discount on your bill for 4 pax, if you eat in the restaurants on certain days

·       Staff trips and staff events over the year – e.g. Ice skating, Tivoli

·       Maybe you join our restaurant Smukfisk at SmukFest festival in Skanderborg

·       Chance to participate in Danish Oyester Cup, when we attend this event

International students that only can work 10-15 hours/week are also welcome. 

Only apply for the job, if you live close by and are able to come to work and stay untill your shift ends at night. Its a non-negotiable.

Please note, getting a job in one of our places is subject to a valid Danish work permit and Danish bank account. So you must be able to get a CPR number (personal identification number ) and a work permit in Denmark.

Please send an e-mail to info@jobsaka.dk with your; application - photo, - and please inform us about where in the process your are, regarding obtaining a Danish work permit.

Header in e-mail MUST clearly state; the job role & if you seek parttime or full time.

If your headder is not displaying this, your applications will not be taken into account, thanks.

jobs.occupation: KØKKEN SOUSCHEF SØGES TIL SPISEHUSET DRAGØR SEJLKLUB
jobs.description:
Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst køkken souschef til en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Om restauranten

Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub ligger ved Dragør Havn i en historisk bygning fra 1863. Restauranten har fokus på god mad, god service og en hyggelig atmosfære. Køkkenet står for den daglige restaurantdrift samt selskaber og arrangementer, og der er derfor fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og godt samarbejde i køkkenet.

Som køkken souschef bliver du en central del af den daglige køkkendrift og arbejder tæt sammen med køkkenchefen og det øvrige køkkenpersonale. Stillingen indebærer både praktisk køkkenarbejde samt ansvar for koordinering og ledelse af køkkenpersonalet.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

• 
Assistere køkkenchefen med den daglige ledelse og koordinering

• 
Varetage køkkendriften ved køkkenchefens fravær

• 
Fordele og koordinere arbejdsopgaver blandt køkkenpersonalet

• 
Planlægge mise en place og øvrig forberedelse

• 
Deltage aktivt i madlavning og produktion

• 
Sikre kvalitet, smag og ensartethed i retterne

• 
Oplære og vejlede nye medarbejdere

• 
Medvirke til planlægning af bemanding og arbejdsflow

• 
Kontrollere varemodtagelse, lager og råvareforbrug

• 
Sikre overholdelse af hygiejne- og fødevaresikkerhedsregler

• 
Bidrage til en effektiv drift under både almindelig service og selskaber

Vi søger dig, der

• 
Har relevant erfaring fra et professionelt køkken

• 
Har erfaring som souschef, køkkenansvarlig, teamleder eller tilsvarende

• 
Har erfaring med koordinering eller ledelse af køkkenpersonale

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for køkkendriften

• 
Er struktureret, stabil og ansvarsbevidst

• 
Kan bevare overblikket under travle services

• 
Har fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og fødevaresikkerhed

• 
Kan kommunikere på engelsk. Dansk er en fordel.

Vi tilbyder

• 
Fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

• 
En central rolle med ansvar for den daglige køkkendrift

• 
Tæt samarbejde med køkkenchef og øvrigt personale

• 
Varierende arbejdsopgaver inden for restaurant- og selskabsdrift

• 
Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

• 
Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

• 
Ansættelse på almindelige danske vilkår

Arbejdstiden kan omfatte dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.

ENGLISH

KITCHEN SOUS CHEF WANTED FOR SPISEHUSET DRAGØR SEJLKLUB

Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub is looking for an experienced and responsible Kitchen Sous Chef for a permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week.

About the restaurant

Spisehuset Dragør Sejlklub is located at Dragør Harbour in a historic building dating from 1863. The restaurant focuses on good food, good service and a welcoming atmosphere. The kitchen is responsible for daily restaurant service as well as private functions and events, with a strong focus on quality, efficiency and teamwork.

As Kitchen Sous Chef, you will play a central role in the daily kitchen operation and work closely with the Head Chef and the rest of the kitchen team. The position includes both practical kitchen work and responsibility for coordinating and supervising kitchen staff.

Main responsibilities

• 
Assist the Head Chef with the daily management and coordination of the kitchen

• 
Take responsibility for the kitchen operation when the Head Chef is absent

• 
Distribute and coordinate tasks among kitchen staff

• 
Plan mise en place and other preparation

• 
Take an active part in cooking and food production

• 
Ensure quality, taste and consistency of dishes

• 
Train and guide new employees

• 
Assist with staffing and workflow planning

• 
Monitor deliveries, stock and ingredient usage

• 
Ensure compliance with food hygiene and food safety requirements

• 
Contribute to efficient operations during both regular service and private functions

About you

• 
Relevant professional kitchen experience

• 
Experience as a Sous Chef, Kitchen Supervisor, Team Leader or similar

• 
Experience coordinating or supervising kitchen staff

• 
Able to work independently and take responsibility for kitchen operations

• 
Organised, reliable and responsible

• 
Able to remain calm during busy services

• 
Focused on quality, efficiency and food safety

• 
Able to communicate in English. Danish is an advantage.

We offer

• 
Permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week

• 
A central role with responsibility for daily kitchen operations

• 
Close cooperation with the Head Chef and kitchen team

• 
Varied duties within restaurant and private-function operations

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development

• 
Salary based on experience and qualifications

• 
Employment on ordinary Danish terms

Working hours may include daytime, evening and weekend shifts.

jobs.occupation: CE-Licensed Drivers Wanted for Night and Evening Shifts
jobs.description:

FragtDK ApS is experiencing increased demand and is therefore looking for 2–4 new, experienced, and reliable drivers holding a Category CE driving licence.

•

• 
Have experience driving 25.25-metre modular vehicle combinations (link combinations)

Are flexible and able to work evening and night shifts

Are prepared for the majority of the driving to take place at night and to stay overnight in the vehicle when necessary

Fixed shifts with predictable working hours

Salary based on qualifications

A good and friendly working environment at FragtDK ApS

FragtDK ApS
Hovedgaden 429
2640 Hedehusene
CVR 41505125

jobs.occupation: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English
·         Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

jobs.occupation: Allround-håndværker søges til fast ansættelse/All-round tradesperson wanted for full-time position
jobs.description:
Dansk:

Vi søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst allround-håndværker, som har primært erfaring og gode faglige kompetencer inden for tømrer- og malerfaget.

Arbejdsopgaverne vil blandt andet omfatte tømrerarbejde og mindre renoveringsopgaver, opbygning og afretning af undergulve, lægning af klikgulve, lamelgulve og massive trægulve samt montering af lister, paneler, aflslibning af trægulve og behandling af trægulve. Derudover vil arbejdet bestå af spartling, opsætning af filt og maling af vægge, lofter og træværk.

Der kan også forekomme reparationer, vedligeholdelse og forskellige mindre håndværksopgaver, som kan berøre eller trække på andre håndværksfag.

Vi leder efter en fagligt dygtig og alsidig person med relevant brancheerfaring. Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar for dine opgaver og levere et pænt resultat med fokus på kvalitet og detaljer.

Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk. Kørekort er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder fast fuldtidsansættelse med ordnede forhold, løn efter kvalifikationer og varierede opgaver i Storkøbenhavn og Nordsjælland. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde, ansvarlighed og høj faglig kvalitet vægtes højt.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt mandag til fredag kl. 7.00–15.00. Opstart hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

jobs.occupation: Senior Immersion Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a naval architect, maritime engineer or offshore engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbor (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As an Immersion Engineer, you will participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In the first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In the second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, assisting the Immersion Master by giving technical advice.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

• 
During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

• 
You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

• 
You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands

• 
You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

• 
You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

• 
You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

• 
During float up and ballasting you check if the operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

• 
During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations.

• 
You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

• 
After immersion, you will do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

• 
You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

• 
You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

• 
You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

• 
You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

• 
You are a team player with strong communication skills

• 
You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

• 
You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

jobs.occupation: Senior Research Adviser for EU, International Funding, Innovation and Impact, Faculty of Health Sciences
jobs.description:
Are you curious about how FP10 will change the opportunities and requirements facing universities? Are you interested in the growing expectations for innovation and impact arising from research? And would you like to work both strategically and closely with researchers and projects, with one clear objective: to strengthen SUND’s international position and secure more external funding?

Then you could play a central role in SUND Research Support. We are looking for an experienced research adviser who from 1 December 2026 can serve as our key specialist for EU and international funding opportunities – and help prepare the unit for tomorrow’s requirements in relation to funding, project delivery, innovation and societal impact.

Responsibilities
You will take an overview of EU and international funding: from developments in Horizon Europe and FP10 to specific calls, partnerships and opportunities for SUND researchers. You will translate policy and programme developments into action and help us position ourselves early as new agendas emerge.

The role spans strategic intelligence and portfolio oversight through to hands-on advice and coordination of prioritised initiatives. Some days you will work on long-term EU positioning and pipeline development; on others, closely with a researcher, an international consortium or a specific call. We do not expect you to do everything yourself, but you will need to spot opportunities, bring together the right expertise and drive progress.

Innovation and impact are important parts of the role. You will strengthen our impact-upfront approach and ensure that requirements relating to involvement, uptake, implementation and knowledge valorisation are considered early. At the same time, you will contribute to a smooth transition from pre-award to post-award, so that project delivery is considered from the outset and lessons from funded projects and project implementation feed into new applications.

You will be both a key contributor to specific EU and international initiatives and a co-developer of our shared models, workflows and portfolio overview. The aim is a more coherent approach to international funding – not simply more individual applications.

Qualifications
We are looking for an experienced professional who thrives at the intersection of research, EU policy, funding, innovation and impact. You have solid experience of EU or international funding, research development or research support, and a good knowledge of Horizon Europe or other major international programmes.

You work strategically and analytically but are also keen to turn insight into tangible results. You are a strong coordinator and relationship-builder who can navigate complex processes, bring together expertise and build trust with researchers, colleagues and management. You communicate confidently in both Danish and English.
It is an advantage if you also have experience of areas such as EU policy, international consortia, Brussels networks, post-award, innovation, societal impact or knowledge valorisation. We do not expect you to be an expert in all of these areas. A PhD or other research experience may be an advantage but is not essential.

In addition, you have an understanding of and a desire to work with digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI) in relation to optimizing processes and creating value within the organization. 

About SUND Research Support and the Faculty of Health Sciences
SUND Research Support assists researchers at the Faculty of Health Sciences at SDU from the early idea and funding opportunity through to application, project delivery, innovation and impact.

We aim to work more proactively with funding intelligence, positioning, partnerships and long-term pipelines – and to create stronger links between pre-award, post-award, innovation and impact. At the same time, we want to use data, organisational learning and AI more systematically.

You will have the opportunity both to work directly with researchers and projects and to help shape how a modern research support function should operate in the years ahead. You will play a central role in SUND’s international funding activities in the run-up to FP10 and help create stronger links between EU/international funding, post-award, innovation and impact.

You will work closely with strong health sciences research environments, management teams and colleagues with a range of specialist profiles. We are interested in new ways of working and in how data, digital tools and AI can add value to research support. This is an opportunity both to deliver results today and to help shape how we work tomorrow.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.
As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

Read more about the Faculty of Health Sciences here.

Contact
If you would like more information about the position, you are welcome to contact head of SUND Research Support Anne Kathrine Overgaard, tlf. 60111043, e-mail: aovergaard@health.sdu.dk or Head of Education and Secretariat Merete Munk på mmunk@health.sdu.dk.

Application Process
The application deadline is 29 September 2026 at 11:59 PM. We expect to conduct interviews 7 October 2026. 

Employment starts on 1 December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Salary and Terms of Employment
Your place of employment will be the University of Southern Denmark in Odense, Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

There may be limited travel activity to other SDU campus cities.

Employment is in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and collective agreement for academics (AC).

The position is full time.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range of the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

If you are interested in the position, you must submit an application that includes a cover letter, CV indicating months and years (without photo), and diploma. All documents related to the application should not contain photos or CPR numbers – if so, the CPR number must be redacted.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. The cover letter and CV must not exceed 5 MB.

Guidance on the application process can be found here.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified applicants, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About SDU
The University of Southern Denmark exists to create value for and with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we aim to make a positive difference for society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talent. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. It is the university’s researchers, teachers, students, leaders, and technical-administrative staff who form the foundation of our success.

jobs.occupation: Seasonal Work – Tyre Fitters Wanted
jobs.description:
Are you practical, enjoy physical work and thrive in a fast-paced environment? We are currently looking for 5 tyre fitters for the upcoming tyre-changing season in Roskilde City.

About the job

As a tyre fitter, your main responsibility will be to help our customers safely change from summer to winter tyres. The work takes place in a professional workshop, where the season can be very busy and good teamwork is essential.

Your duties will include:

• 
Removing and fitting wheels and tyres

• 
Changing between summer and winter wheels

• 
Checking tyre pressure and the general condition of the tyres

• 
Moving and handling wheels and tyres

• 
Preparing and keeping the work area clean and tidy

• 
Where required, washing and registering customers’ wheels

We expect you to

• 
Be reliable, punctual and hardworking

• 
Be able to work efficiently while maintaining a high standard of quality

• 
Be physically fit, as the work involves lifting

• 
Be able to work both independently and as part of a team

• 
Be flexible regarding working hours during the busy season

• 
Speak and understand Danish or English

Previous experience as a tyre fitter, mechanic or in similar work is an advantage, but not necessarily a requirement. You will receive instruction and training in the relevant tasks.

We offer

• 
Seasonal work during a busy and attractive period

• 
Good working conditions

• 
Thorough introduction to the job and tasks

• 
A good and friendly working environment

• 
Competitive pay in accordance with the applicable 3F collective agreement

• 
Full-time work as a starting point, with the possibility of additional working hours during the peak season

Employment period

The position is a temporary seasonal role in connection with the autumn tyre-changing season. The exact employment period and working hours will be agreed individually.

Interested?

Please send your application or a short description of yourself and your experience as soon as possible.

Email: humanizer@pshr.dk
Phone: +45 53 53 11 99

Apply directly online:
https://humanizer.temponizer.dk/index.php?page=ansoeg

Please mark your application: Tyre Fitter

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, and we will hire candidates as soon as we find the right people.

We look forward to hearing from you.
